action.description: The operation to perform. 'write' creates or replaces a page (requires slug + description + content). 'read' returns the full page body (requires slug; only valid for slugs in the index). 'list' returns the current index. 'remove' deletes a page (requires slug); rarely needed, prefer 'write' to correct a page.

slug.description: Page identifier (lowercase, hyphens, max 60 chars). Required for write, read, and remove; omitting it returns an error. For file paths, replace dots and slashes with hyphens (e.g. pkg/utils.py → pkg-utils-py).

description.description: One-line index entry shown in the knowledge index. Required for write. Keep under 80 chars.

content.description: Full page body in markdown. Required for write. Cross-link other pages with [text](/pages/slug.md).

examples.description: How the service is deployed and which variables it reads.
